$comment: The single source of truth for this project's values. Build scripts read it via build/lib/project-config.mjs; the maker/checker agents read it directly. Nothing else should restate these values. Run `npm run init` to fill it in.

modules.$comment: Where the work lands, by role. ODC: kind library | app. O11: kind CrossDevice | ReactiveLibrary, and app names its application. npm run init fills these with the playbook's default names.

platformKnowledge.$comment: OutSystems' frontend-skills pack at vendor/outsystems-frontend-skills, which the lsg plugin reads for platform facts. `vendored-copy` until the upstream repo can be a pinned `submodule`; the path is the same either way. Never edit it.
